content.title: Why the metal powering your electronics is so expensive right now
content.description:
Copper (HG=F) hit a record high earlier today. Disruptions at large mines and disappointing forecasts from leading producers like Glencore (GLEN.L) have led to increased worries over a supply shortage. The industrial metal is used in everything from construction to making electric cars.
